item.title: 'The Music of Zimmer vs Williams' comes to Singapore in January 2026
item.description: Get ready to relive your favourite movie moments — with a full orchestra. On 25 January 2026, The Music of Zimmer vs Williams is coming to Fort Canning Green for a one-night-only epic showdown between two of the biggest names in film scoring: Hans Zimmer and John Williams. Presented by TEG Asia and performed live by the Metropolitan Festival Orchestra, the concert will feature a 70-piece ensemble breathing life into the iconic soundtracks of Hollywood’s most unforgettable blockbusters. item.title: WOLF HOWL HARMONY electrify BIG MOUNTAIN debut with a powerful performance — gig report
item.description: WOLF HOWL HARMONY stormed into Southeast Asia’s largest outdoor music event with their debut appearance at BIG MOUNTAIN MUSIC FESTIVAL 15 in Khao Yai, Thailand. The quartet, celebrated for their exceptional harmonies and commanding stage presence, performed across the festival’s two-day run from 6 and 7 December, marking a major milestone in their expanding footprint across the region. item.title: Megadeth legend Marty Friedman to bring blazing guitar riffs to Singapore in April 2026
item.description: Virtuoso shredder Marty Friedman is heading back to Singapore for a one-night-only show at Foo Chow Hall on 14 April 2026, as part of the Singapore Rockfest concert series. Presented by LAMC, the upcoming concert is part of the legendary guitarist’s world tour, where he showcases his groundbreaking solo work alongside fan-favourite hits from his iconic Megadeth days. item.title: “Inspiration is everywhere”: A conversation with J-rock legend Show Wesugi
